<entry id="N01112">
<head-word>נַצְחָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced. wds.) 
<italic>victor</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. נַצְחִין</plural-form>. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 כליל ריש דנ' the crown of the chief of victors. Targ. Ex. XXXII, 18 (O. ed. Berl. דנָצְחִין, v. נְצַח).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N01113">

<sense>

<notes> Sot. VIII, 1 בנִיצְחוֹנוֹ של וכ' (Y. ed. בנצחת ב"וד, corr. acc.) relying on the strength of &c.; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>praise, song</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXXIV; Yalk. Ps. 833 כל מי שרואה … נותן עליה נ' whoever sees that wine press (Is. LXIII, 1 sq.), gives forth songs over it.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N01120">
<head-word>נְצֵי</head-word>
<head-word>נְצָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be pressed; to shrink, be lean</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="N01094">נָצָא II</xref>.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to wrangle</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. XXVI, 20, sq.; a. fr.—Part. נָצֵי, נָאצֵי; f. נַצְיָא; 
<plural-form>pl. נָצָן</plural-form>. Targ. Prov. XXVI, 17 נא' ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. נְצֵי, corr. acc.). Ib. XXVII, 15. Targ. Ex. II, 13; a. e.—M. Kat. 16
<sup>a</sup> דנְצִינָן וכ' that we (the court) must contend (with persons disregarding legal summonses) and curse &c.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְנַצֵּי, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְנְצֵי, אִינְּ'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Lev. XXIV, 10. Targ. Gen. XLV, 24; a. fr.—B. Mets. 84
<sup>b</sup> הוה קא מִינַּצְיָא וכ' his wife was quarrelling with &c. Kidd. 76
<sup>a</sup> נשי דכי מִינְּצוּ בהדי הדדי בעריות הוא דמִינְּצוּ when women quarrel with one another, they will eventually reproach one another with unchaste conduct; גברי … ביוחסין הוא דמינצו when men quarrel, they will reproach each other with spurious descent (if there is any rumor about it). Ib
<sup>b</sup>. כיון דמִנְּצוּ בהדי אינשי (or דמְנַצּוּ 
<italic>Pa</italic>.) because they (charity collectors) expose themselves to reproaches. Ib. והוה קא מִנְּצֵי איהו וכ' (or מְנַצֵּי) he and Rab Bibi strove with each other, one saying, I want the town office &c. Meg. 24
<sup>a</sup> משום דאתי לאִינַּצּוּיֵי because it may come to quarrels between them. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> אינצי אביו ומינצי רבו Ms. M. (ed. נִיצּוּיֵי) his father may take up the quarrel for him, or his teacher. B. Kam. 117
<sup>a</sup> מנצו, v. שׁוּתָא III; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נַצֵּי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. Targ. Koh. III, 7; a. e.—Meg. 24
<sup>a</sup> קטן בר נַצּוּיֵי הוא will a minor quarrel (about precedence)? Ber. 56
<sup>a</sup> מְנַצּוּ (Beth N. מִינְּצֵי); a. e. (v. supra).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N01131">
<head-word>נָצַל</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. אצל)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to remove, set aside</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִצֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to empty, ransack</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Esth. R. to III, 9 עד שנִצְּלוּ את מצרים so that they ransacked Egypt.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִצַּל, נִיצַּל, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, נִיצּוֹל </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>*1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be fit for throwing away</italic> (as נֵצֶל), 
<italic>to be decayed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Naz. VII, 56
<sup>b</sup> bot. בשר המת שנִצַּל Ar. (Ar. ed. Rome שנצול; ed. שנתוק), v. נֵצֶל.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to be rescued, saved</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. I לא נִצַּלְתִּי מידו I did not escape his power; Yalk. Num. 750 נוצלתי (read: נִיצַּ'; ed. Liv. נִצּוֹלְתִּי). Yoma 86
<sup>b</sup> כגון שבאת … ונ' הימנה when an opportunity to sin offered itself to him once and again, and he escaped it; Kidd. 39
<sup>b</sup>. Esth. R. to II, 7 עתידין לִינָּצֵל וכ' are destined to be saved through me; עתידין להִנָּצֵל על ידיה be saved through her. B. Bath. 164
<sup>b</sup> שלש … אין אדם ניצול מהן וכ' there are three sins which man cannot escape &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִצִּיל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to save, rescue</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 18 אשתו הִצִּילָתֹו his wife saved him. Ib. משה … הַצִּילֵנוּ O Moses …, save us! Sabb. XVI, 1 מַצִּילִין אותן וכ' we must save them from fire (on the Sabbath). Snh. VIII, 7 שמצילין אותן בנפשן whom we must save (prevent from committing a crime) even at the risk of their lives. Ib. 73
<sup>a</sup> ניתן להַצִּילָהּ בנפשו it is a duty to save her (from rape) at the expense of the assailant’s life; a. fr.—Trnsf. (in ritual and levitical law) 
<italic>to protect</italic>. Ḥull. 55
<sup>b</sup> כל … מַצִּיל בגלודה every part of the skin (which has remained unaffected) protects a flayed animal from being declared 
<italic>ṭ</italic>
<italic>’refah</italic>. Ib. מהו שיַצִּיל וכ' does it form a protection from &c.? Ohol. V, 3 מַצֶּלֶת על הכל protects everything in it from uncleanness; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּצַּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be saved</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Esth. R. to V, 3 כבר הוּצְּלוּ חנניה וכ' Hananiah and his colleagues have long ere this been delivered from the furnace; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>a</sup> השתא אַצּוּלֵי מַצִּילִינָן וכ' since we are bound to save them (on the Sabbath), is it necessary to say that they require burying (when defective)?; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<binyan-name>Ittaf.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתַּצַּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>

<italic>to be saved</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. 18
<sup>a</sup> bot. ומִתַּצְּלַת and thou shalt be saved.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N01133">

<sup>a</sup> איזהו נ' בשר המת שקרש ומוהל שהרתיח a secretion from a corpse which became coagulated, and a liquid secretion exposed to heat. Tosef. Ohol. III, 6; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>

<binyan>

<senses>

<definition>
<italic>to sparkle</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. I, 2
<sup>c</sup> עד שתָּנֵץ החמה; Gen. R. s. 50, a. e. (Pes. 93
<sup>b</sup> עד הנץ), v. הָנֵץ.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to blossom, sprout.</italic></definition>

<entry id="N01233">
<head-word>נָקַף</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. נגף)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to bring in close contact; to knock, strike against, wound</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 7
<sup>b</sup> אין אדם נוֹקֵף וכ' no one on earth bruises his finger, unless it is decreed &c. Ber. 7
<sup>b</sup>; Meg. 6
<sup>b</sup> מי שלבו נוֹקְפוֹ he whom his heart smites (who has no clear conscience). Nidd. 3
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. לבו נוקפו ופורש he may have scruples and separate himself entirely from his wife. Midr. Till. to Ps. IX, v. נֶקֶף.—Maas. Sh. V, 15; Sot. IX, 10 הנוֹקְפִים those who knocked the sacrifices on their heads; expl. ib. 48
<sup>a</sup>; Y. ib. IX, 24
<sup>a</sup> bot.—Part. pass. נָקוּף; f. נְקוּפָה; 
<plural-form>pl. נְקוּפִים, נְקוּפִין; נְקוּפוֹת</plural-form>. Tosef. Ḥull. III, 24 ביצים נ' לקערה eggs cracked open into a dish (Ḥull. 64
<sup>a</sup> טרופות).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִנְקִיף, הִקִּיף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause a knocking together</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. 22
<sup>b</sup> (expl. נקפי) המַנְקִיף את רגליו he who knocks his feet against each other (by his mincing walk; Rashi: who causes his feet to strike against objects on the road); cmp. נָקַשׁ.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bring closely together</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bekh. VII, 6 שמַקִּיף, v. נָקַשׁ. Nidd. X, 7 ומַקֶּפֶת and brings the vessel which contains the Ḥallah near the dough; T’bul Yom IV, 3, sq. Bets. IV, 5 ואין מַקִּיפִין שתי וכ' and you must not move two wine vessels together to put upon them &c.—Esp. (ritual law, in examining an organic defect found in a slaughtered animal) 
<italic>to create a defect similar and near to the one found</italic>, in order to ascertain whether the latter was not the result of an accident after slaughtering; in gen. 
<italic>to compare</italic>. Ḥull. 50
<sup>a</sup> מַקִּיפִים בבני מעים we may compare defects in entrails in which was found a perforation the origin of which is doubtful by making a hole next to it. Ib. מקיפין בקנה we may compare defects in windpipes; a. fr.—Kidd. 40
<sup>a</sup> אין מקיפין בחילול השם no comparing (balancing of sins against good deeds) is granted when the Name of God is profaned; (oth. interpret., v. נָקַף II).—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מוּקָּף 
<italic>brought near</italic>. Erub. 30
<sup>b</sup>; Ḥull. 7
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr. לתרום שלא מן המ' to take T’rumah out of a mass which is not in close neighborhood of those products which are to be redeemed; Bicc. II, 5; Ter. IV, 3; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N01234">
<head-word>נְקַף</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to strike, knock, push down</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. CXL, 5. Targ. O. Ex. XXXIV, 20 ותִיקְּפֵיה ed. Berl. (oth. ed., a Y. ותִנְקְ'; ed. Vien. ותַנְקְ' 
<italic>Af</italic>.; h. text וערפתו). Targ. Deut. XXI, 4 (O. ed. Berl. ויַקְּ', 
<italic>Af</italic>.); a. e.—Part. pass. נְקִיף; f. נְקִיפָא. Ib. 6 (O. ed. Vien. נְקֶפְתָּא).—Erub. 53
<sup>b</sup> (enigmatic speech) עלת נַקְפַת בכד ידאון וכ' the ladle strikes against the jug, shall the eagles fly to their nests (the wine is gone, shall the students go home)?</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נַקֵּף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. CXL, 12 (Ms. 
<italic>Pe</italic>.).—Part. pass. מְנַקַּף. Ber. 6
<sup>a</sup> כרעי דמְנַקְּפֵי bruised feet; Yoma 53
<sup>a</sup>, v. נְגַף.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַנְקֵף, אַקֵּף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same; v. supra.—2) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to knock the feet against each other, to mince</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="N01233">preced.</xref>
<italic>Hif.</italic>).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. III, 16 (h. text טפף).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to compare defects</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="N01233">preced.</xref>
<italic>Hif.</italic>).</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 50
<sup>a</sup> אַקְּפִינְהוּ ולא וכ' they compared them, and they did not look alike.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְנַקֵּף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to knock against, to stumble</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Esth. IV, 13.—Yoma l. c. מִינַּקְּפִין Ar. ed. Koh., v. נְגַף.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N01235">
<head-word>נָקַף</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="S00486"> cmp. קוּף </xref>a.
<xref rid="A00083"> נָקַב)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to circle; to bore</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. נָקוּף; f. נְקוּפָה. Gen. R. s. 100, v. נָקַב.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִקִּיף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to surround</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. I, 8 (15
<sup>b</sup>) והִקִּיפוּהָ (ב)כלי בהמה and they surrounded it (the camp) with utensils of travel (wagons, saddles &c.). Ib. 9 מַקִּיפִין שלשה וכ' you may surround the camp with three ropes &c. (for Sabbath purposes). Ib. 53
<sup>b</sup> מצאתי שמקיפין אותה גנות וכ' I found that gardens and orchards surrounded the town (making it inaccessible); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to go around</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mekh. B’shall. s. 1 אַקִּיפֵם במדבר וכ' I shall make them go around in the desert forty years; ib. הריני מַקִּיפָן וכ'. Snh. VIII, 1 עד שיַקִּיף וכ' until he has grown hair around &c., v. זָקֵן.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cut all around</italic>, esp. (with ref. to Lev. XIX, 27) 
<italic>to cut around the corners of the hair of the head</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Naz. 57
<sup>b</sup> אחד המַקִּיף ואחד הנִיקָּף he who cuts and he whose hair is cut are alike guilty; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to sell on terms</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="V00879">תְּקוּפָה</xref>), 
<italic>to lend.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ab. III, 16 החנוני מַקִּיף the shopkeeper allows credit (the Lord is long-suffering). B. Kam. 79
<sup>a</sup> top גנב וה' if he stole an animal and sold it on credit (and has received no pay); a. fr.—Kidd. 40
<sup>a</sup> אין מַקִּיפִין וכ' no loan on time is granted (no chance for repentance is allowed), when the Name of the Lord is profaned; (oth. interpret., v. נָקַף I).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּקָּף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be surrounded</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Arakh. 33
<sup>b</sup>; Meg. 3
<sup>b</sup> שה' ולבסוף וכ' it was surrounded (a fort was built) and then settled; a. fr.—Part. מוּקָּף; f. מוּקֶּפֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מוּקָּפִין; מוּקָּפוֹת</plural-form>. Ib. I, 1 המ' חומה וכ' fortified since the days of Joshua. Ib. 2
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. 4
<sup>b</sup>. Gen. R. s. 39, v. פָּתִיל; a. fr.—Mekh. B’shall., s. 1 מוקפות 
<italic>semicircular</italic></notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיקָּף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to have one’s hair cut all around</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Naz. l. c., v. supra. Ib. כל היכא דנ' מיחייב וכ' whenever he who has his hair cut &c. is punishable (is not a minor or a woman), the cutter is punishable; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיקֵּף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to collect fruit which remained in the crown of the tree</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="unknown">נִיקּוּף II</xref>), 
<italic>to glean olives</italic> (corresp. to פֵּאֵר, Deut. XXIV, 20).</definition>
<notes> Gitt. V, 8 עני המְנַקֵּף … מה שתחתיו גזל when the poor man does the gleaning on the top of the olive tree, what falls down under him is forbidden to any other person; Y. ed. המנ' בראש הזית גזל (corr. acc.; v. ib. 47
<sup>c</sup> top).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cut all around, trim</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 119
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. ib. XI, 18 מְנַקְּפֵי היגין those who trim shrubs. Ib. השוכר … לנַקֵּף עמו וכ' if one hires a laborer to help him trim &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N01241">
<head-word>נָקַר</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="S02192"> cmp. קָרַר I)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to dig, chisel</italic>, esp. 
<italic>to whet a millstone</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. 10
<sup>a</sup> נוֹקְרִין ריחים וכ' you may roughen a millstone during the festive week. Sot. 46
<sup>b</sup> ולִנְקוֹר, v. infra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>to bore, perforate; to put out</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 130
<sup>a</sup> יִקְּרוּ את מוחו they shall perforate (or put out) his brain. Sot. I, 8 נָקְרוּ פלשתים וכ' (or נִקְּרוּ) the Philistines put out his eyes; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (of birds, mice, serpents &c.) 
<italic>to pick, gnaw at</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Ter. VII, 17. Y. ib. III, beg. 42
<sup>a</sup> בשראו אותו נוֹקֵר when they saw the bird pick; a. fr.—[Y. Yeb. X, 11
<sup>a</sup> top לבי נוקריני, v. נָקַד I.]—Part. pass. נָקוּר; 
<plural-form>pl. נְקוּרִים, נְקוּרִין</plural-form>. Y. Ter. l. c. Tosef. l. c. שמא נ' היו may be they were already picked at (by birds); a. e.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיקֵּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. M. Kat. l. c. מְנַקֵּר ריחים, v. supra. Sot. IX, 5 ולנַקֵּר שם וכ' (ib. 46
<sup>b</sup> ולנקור) and to chisel stones there.—Pes. 8
<sup>b</sup> תרנגולתך מְנַקֶּרֶת וכ' (not מנקר) thy hen shall be picking in the dunghill &c. Toh. IV, 3 היו מְנַקְּרִין בהן וכ' if they have been picking them (the pieces of carrion) on the ground; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיקַּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>

<notes> Y. Ter. VIII, 45
<sup>c</sup> top תאנים שנִיקְּרוּ … figs or grapes which have been picked at.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N01242">
<head-word>נְקַר</head-word>

<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. Y. Num. XXI, 35. Targ. I Sam. XI, 2 מִיקַּר (ed. Wil. מֵיקַר); a. e.—Yalk. Prov. 963 דין נָקֵיר וכ' the one (the raven) picks the eye out, and the other (the eagle) eats it; Midr. Sam. ch. VII נָאקֵר.—Pesik. B’shall., p. 93
<sup>b</sup> one worm דעתידא דנַקְרָא וכ' which shall bite me behind the ear.—Y. Sabb. XII, beg. 13
<sup>c</sup> ההן דנ' כיפין וכ' he who chisels stones, columns, millstones &c.; a. e.—Part. pass. נְקִיר. Kidd. 80
<sup>b</sup> אם איתא דנ' וכ' if it had been picked at (by the hens after drinking of a red liquid), it would have been noticeable.</notes></sense></senses>

<sense>
<definition />

<sup>a</sup> דקא מְנַקֵּר ריחיא (Ms. M. נְקַרִ) whetted millstones &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N01243">

<sense>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to keep clean</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 41
<sup>b</sup> הרוצה לנַקֵּר וכ' (Ar. לוַקֵּד) he who wishes to keep his court clean.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<sense>
<definition>

<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<sup>b</sup>) המַקִּישׁ בקרסוליו וכ' he who knocks his ankle-bones against each other (in walking, because his legs are bent outward), or rubs his legs against each other (his feet being bent outward). Midr. Sam. ch. IX מַקֶּשֶׁת ברגליה ומקשת בקרניה she knocks (creates a loud sound) with her feet and with her horns. Zab. IV, 1, sq. ה' על וכ' if he knocked against &c. Meg. 12
<sup>b</sup> (play on בן קיש, Esth. II, 5) שה' על וכ' (Ms. M. שנָקַשׁ) he (Mordecai) knocked at the gates of mercy &c.; a. fr.—Esp. (cmp. נָגַן, נָכָה) 
<italic>to strike an instrument, play</italic>. Tam. VII, 3. Gen. R. s. 18 (play on הפעם, Gen. II, 23) עתידה להַקִּישׁ עלי כזוג (‘Rashi’: לקשקש) she is destined to be loud against me like a bell. Pesik. R. s. 31; Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXXVII אני מבקש שתעמדו ותַקִּישׁוּ … כדרך שהייתם מַקִּישִׁין וכ' I desire that you play on the cithern before me and the idol, as you played before your God. Ib. אנו עומדים להַקִּישׁ וכ' shall we stand playing before this dwarf (Nebuchadnezzar) and this idol? Ib. to Ps. XCII, end (play on יקשן, Gen. XXV, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> שהיו מקישין בתוף לעכו"ם they struck the timbrel before idols; Yalk. Chr.</definition>
<notes> 1073; Gen. R. s. 61 מקשין בית' (corr. acc.).—2) (cmp. נָקַף) 
<italic>to bring under the same category by juxtaposition, to compare</italic>. Kidd. 5
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. (ref. to ויצאה a. והיתה in the same verse, Deut. XXIV, 2) מקיש הויה ליציאה, v. הֲוָיָה. Snh. 60
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Ex. XXII, 19 a. XXXIV, 14) זביחה בכלל … להַקִּישׁ אליה slaughtering for the idol would have been included in worshipping, and why is it singled out? To compare all other idolatrous functions 
<pgbrk id="pg936" />with it: as slaughtering is a function performed inside &c. Zeb. 5
<sup>b</sup> הִקִּישׁוֹ הכתוב וכ' the text (Lev. VII, 37) places it side by side with peace offerings; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<entry id="N01284">
<head-word>נָשָׂא</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. נָסָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lift up, carry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. 35
<sup>a</sup> נ' ארון את נוֹשְׂאָיו the Ark carried its carriers. Ab. ch. VI נוֹשֵׂא בעול וכ' helps his brother to bear his yoke. Ber. III, 1 נוֹשְׂאֵי המטה, v. מִטָּה. Meg. 9
<sup>a</sup> (one of the changes in translating the Bible into Greek) נוֹשֵׂא בני אדם a carrier of men (for חֲמֹר, Ex. IV, 20); a. v. fr.—Pesik. R. s. 6 אני מרומם ונושא את ראשם I will raise and elevate their head; v. infra.—נ' כפים, v. כַּף.—נ' פנים 
<italic>to lift up the face, to respect, favor, spare, be partial</italic>. Ḥag. 14
<sup>a</sup> (expl. נשוא פנים, Is. III, 3) זה שנוֹשְׂאִין פ' לדורו בעבורו he for whose sake his generation is favored in heaven. Sabb. 13
<sup>b</sup> שלא נ' פ' לתורה who spared him not for the sake of his scholarship. Yoma 87
<sup>a</sup> שנָשְׂאוּ לו פ' בעה"ז that indulgence was shown him (by the Lord) in this world. Num. R. s. 11 לא אֶשָּׂא פ' מפניך shall I not favor thee for thy own sake? Ib. כשם שהם נוֹשְׂאִין לי וכ' as they (the Israelites) honor me (by saying grace even after a scanty meal), so do I favor them; a. fr.—נ' נפש אל 
<italic>to lift up the soul to, to long for</italic>. Midr. Till. to Ps. XXV, 1 למה אתה נושא נפשך אלי why dost thou lift up thy soul to me (why dost thou depend on me)?; Yalk. ib. 701.—נ' קרבן 
<italic>to offer up a sacrifice</italic>. Ib. 702 אדם חוטא ונושא ק' if a man sinned, he offered &c.; Midr. Till. l. c. נושא ומביא ק' (corr. acc.)—Part. pass. נָשׂוּא, f. נְשׂוּאָה &c. Ib. עכשו … הרי נפשנו נ' לך now that we have no sacrifices, our soul is lifted up to thee.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lift, remove</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. l. c. (ref. to the double meaning of נ', 
<italic>to raise</italic> a. 
<italic>to remove</italic>) לכו שְׂאוּ את ראשו go and remove (or lift up) his head; a. fr.—נ' עון 
<italic>to forgive</italic>. Y. Snh. X, beg., 27
<sup>c</sup> (ref. to Ex. XXXIV, 7) נושא עוונות אין וכ' the text does not say, ‘removing iniquities’, but ‘removing iniquity’, the Lord takes away (from the scales) one bond of man’s sins, and the merits prevail &c.; Y. Peah I, 16
<sup>b</sup> bot. (corr. acc.); Yalk. Ex. 400; v. שְׁטַר. Pesik. R. s. 45; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to take</italic>, esp. נ' ונתן 
<italic>to take and give, to deal; to transact, argue</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 31
<sup>a</sup> נָשָׂאתָ ונתת באמונה hast thou (while on earth) been dealing honestly? B. Mets. 48
<sup>a</sup> הנושא ונותן בדברים he who concludes a bargain verbally. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 18 כשם שנושאין ונותנין בהלכה וכ' as well as they debate on the law below, so do they above. Ib. שנושאין ונותנין בדין וכ' they argue in court, and the Lord argues with them; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> נ' אשה, or נ' 
<italic>to take a wife into one’s house, to marry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. II, 1 בתולה נְשָׂאתַנִי thou hast married me as a virgin; אלמנה נְשָׂאתִיךְ I married thee as a widow. Yeb. 37
<sup>b</sup> לא יִשָּׂא אדם וכ' one may not marry in one country and go away &c. M. Kat. I, 7 אין נושאין נשים וכ' no marriages may take place during the festive week; a. v. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. נָשׂוּי (followed by accus.) 
<italic>having married</italic>; f. נְשׂוּאָה (followed by ל) 
<italic>being married to; </italic>
<plural-form>pl. נְשׂוּאִים,</plural-form> … אִין; 
<pgbrk id="pg938" />נְשׂוּאוֹת. Yeb. III, 6 ואחד נ' נכרית one of them has married a stranger. Ib. ומתו הנ' את האחיות and those brothers who had married two sisters died. Ib. I, 2 (2
<sup>b</sup>) היתה … נשואה לאחיו Y. ed. (Mish. ed. נשואת, corr. acc.; Bab. ed. נשואות) if his daughter or … was married to &c.; a. fr.—Tosef. ib. VI, 5 נָשׂאוּי.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִישָּׂא</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be lifted up, removed</italic> &c. Pesik. R. l.</definition>
<notes> c. כבר … שיִנָּשְׂאוּ את ראשם וכ' it had been decreed that their head should be lifted (v. supra): turn its meaning and elevate their head.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<pos> f.</pos> נִישֵּׂאת, נִשֵּׂ', נִישֵּׂת, נִיסֵּת 
<italic>to be married</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. I, 1 בתולה נ' וכ' a virgin’s marriage takes place on the fourth day of the week. Ib. V, 2 הגיע … ולא נִשְּׂאוּ if the time set for marriage expired and they were not taken in marriage. Yeb. II, 10 מותרות לִינָּשֵׂא להם they may marry them. Ib. 88
<sup>b</sup> הרי זו לא תִנָּשֵׂא ואם ניסת וכ' she must not marry again, and if she does &c.; Keth. 22
<sup>b</sup>; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשִּׂיא</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lift up, to announce by signals</italic> (the New Moon).</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. II, 2, a. e. מַשִּׂיאִין, v. מַשּׂוּאָה. Y. ib. II, 58
<sup>a</sup> top אין משיאין לילי זמנו we do not raise signals in the night of the regular New Moon (from the 29
<sup>th</sup> to the 30
<sup>th</sup>) &c.; a. fr.—Tosef. ib. II (I), 2 מַסִּיעִין את החדש ed. Zuck. (משיא' על, מסיא') we signalize the New Moon.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to transfer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Deut. R. s. 11 (ref. to ישא, Ps. IXXV, 5) יַשִּׂיא ברכה לאחרים he will bring blessing upon others.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to move, remove, pass</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bets. III, 7 מַשִּׂיאָהּ על גבי חברתה he may pass one knife over the other (to whet it). Tosef. Par. X (IX), 3 הִשִּׂיאוֹ לדבר אחר he diverted his mind towards another subject; Ab. Zar. II, 5. Y. ib. II, 41
<sup>c</sup> bot. היה לו להַשִּׂיאוֹ וכ', v. הֶשֵּׂיאָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to transfer, transcribe, translate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sot. VIII, 6 הִשִּׂיאוּ את הכתב וכ' they transcribed the inscription on the stones in seventy languages; Sot. 35
<sup>b</sup>; Y. ib. VII, 21
<sup>d</sup> bot.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to give away in marriage; to cause to marry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 111
<sup>b</sup> כל המַשִּׂיא בתו וכ' he who marries his daughter to a scholar. Ib. 67
<sup>b</sup> top מַשִּׂיאִין את היתומה וכ' we must first help the fatherless maiden to marry, and then the fatherless lad. Kidd. 29
<sup>a</sup> האב חייב … ולהַשִּׂיאוֹ אשה a father is bound to …, and to provide a wife for him; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
